title: delread~
body:
delread~ and delread4~ objects read from a delay line allocated in a delwrite~ object with the same name. You can use more than one delread~ and/or delread4~ object for the same delwrite~. If the specified delay time is longer than the delay line or less than zero, it is clipped to the length of the delay line. Delay names often use "$0" (the patch ID number) to keep them local to a patch.

In case the delwrite~ runs later in the DSP loop than the delread~ or delread4~ objects, the delay is constrained below by one vector length (usually 64 samples).
